SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.user_nickname AS nickname, u.user_mobile AS mobile, DATE_FORMAT(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS registerTime, u.register_terminal AS registerTerminal, u.grade_id AS gradeId, u.is_admin AS isAdmin, u.user_count_login AS loginCount, DATE_FORMAT(u.user_lastlogin_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastLoginTime, u.user_lastlogin_ip AS lastLoginIp, IFNULL(o.order_count, 0) AS orderCount, IFNULL(o.order_amount, 0) AS orderAmount, DATE_FORMAT(o.last_order_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastOrderTime, IFNULL(o.order_days, 0) AS orderDays, IFNULL(o.order_total_count, 0) AS orderTotalCount, IFNULL(o.order_total_amount, 0) AS orderTotalAmount, IFNULL(o.pending_pay_count, 0) AS pendingPayCount, IFNULL(o.pending_pay_amount, 0) AS pendingPayAmount, IFNULL(b.browse_count, 0) AS browseCount, DATE_FORMAT(b.last_browse_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS lastBrowseTime, t.tag_names AS tagNamesStr, g.fav_goods_name AS favGoodsName, IFNULL(g.bought_kinds, 0) AS boughtGoodsKinds, sh.fav_shop_name AS favShopName FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_info u LEFT JOIN (
SELECT buyer_user_id, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN (1, 7) THEN order_payment_amount ELSE 0 END) AS order_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN (1, 7) THEN order_create_time END) AS last_order_time, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN (1, 7) THEN order_date END) AS order_days, COUNT(*) AS order_total_count, SUM(order_payment_amount) AS order_total_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_pay_count, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 1 THEN order_payment_amount ELSE 0 END) AS pending_pay_amount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base GROUP BY buyer_user_id ) o ON CONVERT(o.buyer_user_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS browse_count, MAX(footprint_time) AS last_browse_time FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_user_footprint WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id <> '' GROUP BY user_id ) b ON CONVERT(b.user_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN ( SELECT tc.member_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ti.tag_name) AS tag_names FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class tc INNER JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_tag_info ti ON FIND_IN_SET(ti.tag_id, tc.tag_id) > 0 WHERE tc.tag_id IS NOT NULL AND tc.tag_id <> '' AND ti.tag_isactive = 1 GROUP BY tc.member_id ) t ON CONVERT(t.member_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.buyer_user_id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(x.goods_name ORDER BY x.cnt DESC, x.goods_name), ',', 1) AS fav_goods_name, COUNT(*) AS bought_kinds FROM ( SELECT og.buyer_user_id, og.goods_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og GROUP BY og.buyer_user_id, og.goods_name ) x GROUP BY x.buyer_user_id ) g ON CONVERT(g.buyer_user_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LEFT JOIN ( SELECT y.buyer_user_id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(y.shop_name ORDER BY y.cnt DESC, y.shop_name), ',', 1) AS fav_shop_name FROM ( SELECT og.buyer_user_id, og.shop_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og GROUP BY og.buyer_user_id, og.shop_name ) y GROUP BY y.buyer_user_id ) sh ON CONVERT(sh.buyer_user_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci WHERE u.is_delete = 0
AND ( u.user_nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(u.user_id AS CHAR) = #{keyword} )
AND IFNULL(o.order_count, 0) >= #{minOrders}
ORDER BY u.user_id LIMIT 5000

SELECT f.user_id AS userId, gc.common_name AS goodsName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_user_footprint f LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc ON gc.common_id = f.common_id WHERE f.user_id IS NOT NULL AND f.user_id <> '' GROUP BY f.user_id, gc.common_name ORDER BY f.user_id, cnt DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS d, COUNT(*) AS created, SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_count, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status NOT IN (1, 7) THEN order_payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS amount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 1 THEN order_payment_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_amount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base WHERE order_create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY d
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class WHERE tag_id IS NOT NULL AND tag_id <> ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base WHERE order_status NOT IN (1, 7)
SELECT id AS gradeId, grade_name AS gradeName, grade_discount AS gradeDiscount FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_membership_grade ORDER BY grade_rule

SELECT x.event_time AS eventTime, x.event_type AS eventType, x.title AS title, x.detail AS detail FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS event_time, 'login' AS event_type, '登录' AS title, CONCAT(IFNULL(NULLIF(l.login_type, ''), '账号登录'), IF(l.device IS NULL OR l.device = '', '', CONCAT(' · ', l.device)), IF(l.ip IS NULL OR l.ip = '', '', CONCAT(' · ', l.ip))) AS detail FROM hou_log_login l WHERE CONVERT(l.user_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND l.login_status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS event_time, 'order' AS event_type, CONCAT('下单 #', o.order_id, CASE o.order_status WHEN 1 THEN '（待付款）' WHEN 3 THEN '（待发货）' WHEN 4 THEN '（已发货）' WHEN 6 THEN '（已确认收货）' WHEN 7 THEN '（已取消）' ELSE '' END) AS title, CONCAT('应付 ¥', FORMAT(o.order_payment_amount, 2)) AS detail FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base o WHERE CONVERT(o.buyer_user_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci ) x ORDER BY x.event_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT og.goods_name AS goodsName, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(og.order_goods_payment_amount) AS amount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og WHERE CONVERT(og.buyer_user_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci GROUP BY og.goods_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT og.shop_name AS shopName, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(og.order_goods_payment_amount) AS amount FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og WHERE CONVERT(og.buyer_user_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND og.shop_name IS NOT NULL AND og.shop_name <> '' GROUP BY og.shop_name ORDER BY cnt DESC, amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT x.band AS band, COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(x.pay), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN og.order_goods_payment_amount < 50 THEN '0-50' WHEN og.order_goods_payment_amount < 100 THEN '50-100' WHEN og.order_goods_payment_amount < 300 THEN '100-300' WHEN og.order_goods_payment_amount < 1000 THEN '300-1000' ELSE '1000+' END AS band, og.order_goods_payment_amount AS pay, CASE WHEN og.order_goods_payment_amount < 50 THEN 1 WHEN og.order_goods_payment_amount < 100 THEN 2 WHEN og.order_goods_payment_amount < 300 THEN 3 WHEN og.order_goods_payment_amount < 1000 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS sort_no FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og WHERE CONVERT(og.buyer_user_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci ) x GROUP BY x.band, x.sort_no ORDER BY x.sort_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods WHERE goods_class_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT ti.tag_id AS tagId, ti.tag_name AS tagName, ti.tag_weight AS tagWeight, COALESCE(ti.tag_color, '#409EFF') AS tagColor, ti.tag_describe AS tagDescribe, ti.tag_isactive AS tagIsactive, DATE_FORMAT(ti.tag_add_data, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc.member_id) FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class tc WHERE tc.tag_id IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(ti.tag_id, tc.tag_id) > 0) AS memberCount FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_tag_info ti WHERE ti.tag_isactive = 1 ORDER BY ti.tag_weight DESC, ti.tag_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_tag_info (tag_name, tag_weight, tag_describe, tag_color, tag_isactive) VALUES (#{tagName}, #{tagWeight}, #{tagDescribe}, COALESCE(#{tagColor}, '#409EFF'), 1)
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(tc.member_id AS UNSIGNED) AS userId, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ti.tag_id ORDER BY ti.tag_id) AS tagIdStr FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class tc INNER JOIN ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_tag_info ti ON FIND_IN_SET(ti.tag_id, tc.tag_id) > 0 AND ti.tag_isactive = 1 WHERE tc.tag_id IS NOT NULL AND tc.tag_id <> '' GROUP BY tc.member_id

SELECT tag_id FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class WHERE CONVERT(member_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class (member_id, tag_id, member_class_id) SELECT #{userId}, NULL, 1 FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class WHERE CONVERT(member_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci )
mapper.update: UPDATE ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class SET tag_id = #{tagIdStr} WHERE CONVERT(member_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci = CONVERT(CAST(#{userId} AS CHAR) USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(tc.member_id AS UNSIGNED) FROM ${database.prefix.base}hou_base_tag_class tc WHERE tc.tag_id IS NOT NULL AND FIND_IN_SET(#{tagId}, tc.tag_id) > 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_portrait_crowd (crowd_name, remark, rule_json, rule_text, member_count, member_ids, create_by) VALUES (#{crowdName}, #{remark}, #{ruleJson}, #{ruleText}, #{memberCount}, #{memberIds}, #{createBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id AS id, crowd_name AS crowdName, remark AS remark, rule_json AS ruleJson, rule_text AS ruleText, member_count AS memberCount, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_portrait_crowd WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 200
